title: CAD bundle manifest
description: manifest.json of a bundle that cad-record layout.py publish() sealed: what it is, which build it binds, the recipe that made it, its files, and the bundle it replaced

params.description: the path template's tokens, such as V and S

version_manifest_sha256.description: sha256 of hw/versions/<V>/manifest.json, or null for a bundle bound to no version

producer.description: the writing tool and its version

status.description: the producer's verdict, such as pass, warn or fail

recipe.description: the producer's normalized inputs and options; no wall time, ports, absolute paths or random ids

recipe_sha256.description: sha256 of the recipe as canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace)

files.description: every file in the bundle but manifest.json, by bundle-relative path

replaces.description: the bundle this one superseded with --replace, retained under .cad-work/replaced/
